title: A special-order part's details name the vendor and bill number
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a special-order part of category A received on a vendor bill (for example Prairie Tire Supply - VB-4821).
  • Have a quick-added part with no vendor, made for this test on work order 1, so its details have no From line.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at the special-order part's sell price.
  3. Point at the quick-added part's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Where it came from reads the vendor's name, " - " and the vendor bill number.

Step 3:

  • The details show the source, rule, cost and sell price.
  • They have no line for where the part came from.
